question.text: A galvanometer coil has 500 turns and each turn has an average area of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3</mn><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow></msup><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math>. If a torque of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>5</mn><mo> </mo><mi>Nm</mi></math> is required to keep this coil parallel to a magnetic field when a current of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>5</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></math> is flowing through it, the strength of the field (in <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">T</mi></math>) is _________ .
